# CI architecture decision and scenario qualification (issue #603, DOD-2)

**Decision:** use the existing complete clean-checkout acceptance graph for every *ready* PR into a protected development line, retain the Phase A same-run bootstrap/staging gains already merged on `release/v0.4`, and adopt the bounded PR #619 change on `release/v0.5`: **zero runner allocation for automatic Draft PR CI and independent reproducibility; full qualification is triggered by `ready_for_review`.** Preserve the strict standalone reproducibility and native/proof status owners. Do not promote speculative source-selective feedback to merge authority or remove apparently duplicated independent tests without parity evidence.

This is an **architecture comparison and source-model decision**, not executable native/proof qualification or a claim that GitHub currently enforces the release line. All observations and provisional interpretations below distinguish exact revisions. Source inventory/authority: [CI-OBLIGATION-AUTHORITY.md](CI-OBLIGATION-AUTHORITY.md); governing tracker: [#603](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/lexlean/issues/603); selected production [PR #619](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/lexlean/pull/619). Only DOD-4 and DOD-5 may declare the production result qualified/landed.

## Competing viable architectures and the selected boundary

| Architecture | Runner-work strategy | Unique assurance preserved? | Quantified observation / risk | Decision |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **A0: unguarded release/v0.5 Draft (observed baseline)** | Automatic Draft launches `plan -> honesty -> rest` plus independent `repro`; Ready fans out all native/Lean/BDD/Atlas jobs. | Full ready gate exists; drafts are nonqualifying feedback. | Historical Draft #544 CI run **43650253312** used **98.914** unweighted job-minutes and repro **43650253301** used **6.600m**, total **105.514m** on **different code/head**. Variable, not a matched per-event A/B. | Reject automatic Draft CPU burn for no merge authority. |
| **A1: conventional staging / bounded dedup (Phase A #602 merged on release/v0.4)** | Stage expensive bootstrap consumers behind their same-run producer; independent jobs do not occupy runners waiting for export. Retain unique BDD partitions, full native hosts, Lean proof and reproducibility. | Yes, when the producer custody and join are verified. | Archived successful full CI **44599982425** vs **45100057759**: **2,148.167 → 1,177.967 unweighted runner-job minutes** and completed-job execution envelope **289.117 → 104.750m** on different source revisions. 28 matched BDD recipe spans **1,094.82 → 179.50m**. These are actual historical observations, **not isolation of causality**. | Preserve the already merged benefits; require separate source-equivalent forward-port, never confuse v0.4 and v0.5. |
| **A2: source-aware selective feedback (#606 Draft experiment)** | Conservative exact-head change classification selects only cheap whitespace, formatting, CI Python contract and transitive package `cargo check` in one bounded worker. Unknown files and manifests fail closed; full ready gate is unchanged. | Yes **only** as nonqualifying optional feedback; it has not established a detector-to-change closure sufficient to replace any protected test. | Hosted pilot 45182363019 refused stale base after **7s runner**, positive 45182928295 failed after **42s**, corrected positive 45183454282 passed after **53s**, different heads/scenarios. One exact-head hosted nonqualifying full-checkout #45208066848 successful. No trustworthy ready-merge savings. | Retain as **optional feedback only**. Do not use its green status to accept or replace full CI. |
| **A3: gated automatic Draft, unchanged Ready graph (#619 chosen for v0.5)** | Automatic Draft `pull_request` schedules **zero jobs with runners** in `ci.yml` and `reproducibility.yml`; jobs all held by `plan`; `ready_for_review`, ready updates, main/release pushes and explicit `workflow_dispatch` restore relevant checks. Independent reproducibility remains. | Yes structurally, provided Ready full event and joins actually pass. RP-14 asserts all 18 job definitions are in planner custody and rejects bypassing `always()`. | Initial hosted draft #619 HEAD `3fa010c6`: CI **45224026799** / repro **45224026842** skipped. Later exact-head `75eda100` CI **45228059024** / repro **45228058762** skipped. Latest inventory commit also skipped. **Observed Draft job allocation = 0**, not a measured causally matched **105.514m** saving, nor a Ready time-to-green reduction. | **Selected incremental production cutover** for release/v0.5. Ready/native/proof/repro qualification remains mandatory. |

**Rejected higher-risk conventional dedup:** `ci.yml -> vv/rest -> repro -> cargo xtask check-reproducibility` overlaps `reproducibility.yml -> just repro -> cargo xtask check-reproducibility`. The command name matches, **but independent clean environment and required-status owner may add distinct assurance**. Separate repro's historical amount was only **~275.668m in the reconciled 50-PR BEFORE total of 88,298.354m** (about **0.312%** of that total, subject to matching source-run selection). The independent context is not removed. Upfront checkout micro-optimizations are dominated by 40-minute BDD and long host/proof jobs and should not be prioritized over proven staging and Draft avoidance.

## Reproducible measurement sources and normalization

- Historical 50-PR BEFORE **88,298.354 unweighted job-minutes** over 128 reconciled final-head runs, sourced from `.github/metrics/ci-before-pr50-runs.json` and `.github/metrics/ci-before-pr50-job-costs-corrected.json` on PR #606 HEAD `a76dc713d66e12305675939a1e90e0c81ea1c28e`. It corrected **11,023.302 phantom minutes** from previously reissued run-attempt metadata, an **accounting fix**, not an optimization.
- Two complete-run measurements: `.github/metrics/ci-full-run-job-attribution-20261123.json`, same PR #606 source HEAD. Each run's `job_elapsed_sum_seconds / 60` gives **2,148.1667** and **1,177.9667** job-minutes, and `job_execution_envelope_seconds / 60` gives **289.1167** and **104.75** minutes. Both runs were `success` with complete job inventories: 72 and 78. Different source revisions `d38af68c` and `b693bb42`: do not conclude exact-source or same-branch causal savings.
- `.github/metrics/ci-bdd-bootstrap-28-matched-20261123.json` and `.github/scripts/ci_bootstrap_staging_audit.py` on #606 record exact selected BDD partition timing and producer custody. These are independent attribution evidence, not a statistical controlled counterfactual.
- `.github/metrics/ci-development-feedback-qualification-20261123.json` records actual pilot seconds/queue and refusals; compare **only** after aligning head, triggers, OS/runner classes and terminal command ownership.
- Current draft comparison: [historical Draft #544 CI](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/lexlean/actions/runs/43650253312) + [repro](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/lexlean/actions/runs/43650253301), and [#619 new Draft CI](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/lexlean/actions/runs/45228059024) + [repro](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/lexlean/actions/runs/45228058762). This **proves a scheduling difference** on live Draft events, **not** same-code 105.514m causal saving, billed dollars or ready acceptance.
- Formula for job-minutes is `sum(max(completed_at - started_at, 0) / 60)` for *complete provider job inventories only*. Do not include skipped or never-allocated work in a spent-minute sum. Job-execution envelope is `last completed job - first started job`; it is **not** PR open-to-merge, and not necessarily the longest path of all required checks if standalone reproducibility or queueing is omitted. Do not infer latency from job-minute sums.
- **Comparable Ready critical path:** unchanged ready fanout in A3 vs A0, so **no defensible ready critical-path improvement is predicted from Draft suppression alone**. Phase A's 289.117m vs 104.75m observed envelopes are cross-revision context, not a same-source A/B. The first actionable failure in old #617 run #45203211800 occurred in setup: `bdd-verification` HTTP 403 after several minutes; `just vv (examples)` later found oracle mismatch. This shows fast refusal is possible, not a controlled time-to-fail improvement. Queue contention and host capacity are real but not deterministically estimated here.
- **Cost:** this is a public repo, so billed cost may be zero, while private-repo-equivalent CPU spending is nonzero. Do not claim actual dollar savings or run-cost multiplier without machine-class rate, billing and minute-rounding evidence.

One reproducibility command in a checkout carrying the #606 evidence blobs (requires Python 3; read-only) is:
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
d=json.loads(Path(".github/metrics/ci-full-run-job-attribution-20261123.json").read_text())
for r in d["runs"]:
    assert r["conclusion"]=="success" and r["provider_total_count"]==r["job_count"]
    assert len(r["jobs"])==r["job_count"] and all(j["conclusion"]=="success" for j in r["jobs"])
    print(r["run_id"],round(r["job_elapsed_sum_seconds"]/60,3),
          round(r["job_execution_envelope_seconds"]/60,3))
PY
```
A3 is implemented against **different source**; its acceptance requires a passing exact-head hosted Ready qualification. No hypothetical job-minute number is elevated to a measured outcome.

## Governed event and failure scenario matrix

Key: **PROVEN** = hosted observed; **SOURCE** = inspected code/negative-model only; **HOLD** = provider acceptance or platform authority still unverified. Every path that affects merge/publication must fail closed on missing evidence.

| Scenario / fault | A0/A1 or optional A2 baseline | Selected A3 #619 expected behavior and verification | State |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Automatic Draft `opened` | A0 spends `honesty+rest+repro`; A2 does not auto-activate | Plan and independent repro skipped; **0 allocated runners** | **PROVEN**, actual #619 initial hosted event |
| 2. Automatic Draft `synchronize` / `reopened` | A0 reruns expensive partial gate | Skip plan and independent repro; no worker escapes planner | **PROVEN** for `synchronize`; `reopened` **SOURCE** |
| 3. Draft becomes Ready on release/main | Entire native/proof/BDD set must run | Both workflows explicitly include `ready_for_review`; full gate and independent repro must run | **SOURCE; hosted Ready HOLD** |
| 4. Ready PR synchronizes or first opens | Full gate | Identical full fanout for all committed `vv` parts, Atlas join, native host joins and separate repro | **SOURCE; exact-head hosted HOLD** |
| 5. Stacked Ready PR to non-main/release base | Honest nonqualifying development signal | Planner emits `honesty+rest`; independent repro retained, cannot merge into release based on stacked status | **SOURCE** |
| 6. Explicit `workflow_dispatch` on draft head | Plan classifies PR head as development signal | Manual feedback permitted; never counts as Ready gate. Explicit independent repro dispatch is also not a full CI success | **SOURCE** |
| 7. Push to main or release | Full gate, except verified same-tree merge reuse | Full normal fanout or plan's **existing** same-tree success-reuse with exact commit/tree and all required job statuses | **SOURCE**, unchanged lineage; release/merge qualified evidence **HOLD** |
| 8. Failed/skipped planner / invalid selector | Must not allocate or accept partial plan | `honesty` has exact success dependency; downstream jobs are all in `plan` custody; missing/malformed source refuses | **SOURCE** with 18-job audit and negative mutants |
| 9. Canceled/interrupted Ready run | Not a passing norm | A canceled/interrupted job is not success and cannot be reused as a green gate; a new exact-head qualified run is needed | **SOURCE**; no hosted cancel acceptance test |
| 10. Missing/stale/foreign bootstrap artifact | Reject stale/missing proof | Same-run `bootstrap-export` read by guarded `take-bootstrap-export.sh` and strict Rust BDD oracle/manifest checks | **SOURCE**; live negative-hosted parity **HOLD** |
| 11. One native host/lane fails | Whole acceptance fails | Linux ARM, macOS ARM, macOS Intel and Windows required; Intel/Windows joins reject missing/failed lane receipts | **SOURCE** plus observed real red #617 host jobs |
| 12. One Lean/Atlas shard or BDD partition fails | Whole gate fails | RP-13 rows remain exhaustive; Atlas join requires all predecessor modules/records | **SOURCE**; real red #617 fixture examples and BDD |
| 13. External setup HTTP 403 / timeout | Availability failure | Refuse that job; do not silently drop the detector or call an unproven pin a fix | **PROVEN** in #617 `bdd-verification`; remediation **HOLD** |
| 14. Release tag, crate packaging, publishing | Separate gate, identity, hash, and credential authority | `tag.yml`, `release.yml`, `crate.yml` unchanged; only published on successful verified release receipt; #607 remains unqualified | **SOURCE**, real new-tag release qualification **HOLD** |
| 15. Regeneration/cut writes generated files | Writer cannot count as acceptance | `regenerate.yml` writer/deliver re-dispatches `ci.yml` on current head; cut invokes writer; no bypass for changed generated tree | **SOURCE**, hosted write-path qualification **HOLD** |
| 16. Nonqualifying optional pilot succeeds/fails | A2 returns selected tests only | Never substitutes for RP-13/RP-14 or full ready host/Atlas/proof/repro status | **PROVEN** nonqualifying pilot, never merge-authority |
| 17. Release line lacks branch protection | No automatic required-status veto | Manual owner-governed merge refusal pending full exact-head status/evidence check; platform return `protected=false` | **PROVEN** readable branch metadata; admin authority bounded |

All source-modeled **HOLD** entries remain explicit acceptance gates of DOD-4/5, **not missing architecture-selection decisions**. No scenario authorizes skipping native platforms or Lean proof merely because their execution is expensive.

## Decision and acceptance / rollback

1. **Keep** accepted Phase A #602 staging and the standalone reproduction owner; do not weaken the verified graph. Moving source modifications between release lines requires independent validation.
2. **Select** A3 #619's guarded automatic Draft as a low-risk **incremental normative** improvement on `release/v0.5`; the hosted Draft behavior has already been observed at multiple heads, including the documentary head. Do not falsely claim this makes full Ready PRs cheap.
3. **Keep** A2 #606 as nonqualifying developer-feedback tooling until explicitly dispositioned; it is **not** a release/merge gate. No other new optimization branch is needed for this DOD.
4. **DOD-4/5 HOLD:** exact candidate HEAD must pass executable RP-14/CL-17/R10 and conformance, all full native/proof/Atlas rows, separate repro, and release-safety receipts. The previous full run #45203211800 is unrelated, red, and consuming resources; it has no cancellation mutation exposed through the connected GitHub app. Do not mark #619 Ready into an overlapping expensive run. GitHub reports `release/v0.5` unprotected; manually enforce all status evidence.
5. **Rollback:** a reviewed revert of #619's `ci.yml` and `reproducibility.yml` Draft guards together with SPEC/RP-14 documentation restores the older draft behavior; preserve DOD-1 inventory and source-correctness patches as independent decisions. Do not revert a certificate semantic-id fix just to mask CI red. Validate rollback behavior before using it for a release.
6. **DOD-6 observation plan:** use the pre-registered 50-PR historical BEFORE inventory and first eligible post-merge PR receipts; record exact head, paired workflows, full required-critical-path, queue, failure timing, runner minutes, host classes, and billed amounts separately. The 50-PR AFTER can accumulate as actual development resumes; publish an honest early cohort, not a synthetic victory.

**Selected architecture is frozen at this decision boundary.** An unanticipated exact-head test failure may require a minimal source correction, not a new option sweep. Reopen DOD-2 only when actual acceptance evidence disproves its assumptions or the required behavior changes.
